UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the CampusConnect application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile, matching Firebase Auth UID.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

linkedinUrl.description: URL of the user's LinkedIn profile.

leetcodeUrl.description: URL of the user's LeetCode profile.

githubUrl.description: URL of the user's GitHub profile.

role.description: Role of the user (e.g., student, faculty, HOD).

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an announcement posted by faculty or HODs.

authorId.description: Reference to UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Announcement).  The user who created the announcement.

attachmentUrls.description: URLs of attached documents, images, or videos.

scheduledAt.description: Date and time the announcement is scheduled to be posted.

createdAt.description: Date and time the announcement was created.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a workshop, tech talk, or hackathon event.

registeredUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Event).  IDs of users registered for the event.

ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: Represents a post in the discussion forum.

id.description: Unique identifier for the forum post.

authorId.description: Reference to UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ForumPost). The user who created the post.

createdAt.description: Date and time the post was created.

upvoteUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N ForumPost).  IDs of users who upvoted the post.

downvoteUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N ForumPost).  IDs of users who downvoted the post.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: Represents a resource file (notes, papers, etc.) uploaded to the resource hub.

description.description: A brief description of the resource.

uploaderId.description: The UID of the user who uploaded the resource.

uploaderName.description: The display name of the user who uploaded the resource.

fileUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the file in Firebase Cloud Storage.

storagePath.description: The full path to the file in Firebase Cloud Storage.

uploadDate.description: Date and time the file was uploaded.

fileType.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf, image/jpeg).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a message within the AI Chatbot.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat message.

userId.description: Reference to UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatMessage). The user who sent the message.

timestamp.description: Date and time the message was sent.

isUserGenerated.description: Indicates if the message was sent by the user or the chatbot.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the CampusConnect application, emphasizing security, scalability, and ease of debugging. It adheres to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC (Database-Based Access Control), and QAPs (Rules are Not Filters). Authorization Independence is achieved through denormalization. For example, access to resources is based on the uploaderId, and any group-based authorization (if implemented later) would require denormalizing group membership into the Resource document. Segregation is applied by using distinct collections for different data types (e.g., user profiles, announcements, events). Access modeling follows consistent patterns: private user data under `/users/{userId}`, and other entities under top-level collections. The design prioritizes clarity with explicit state modeling (if needed later), predictable schemas, and consistent naming conventions.

The structure supports the core features of the application:

*   **User Profiles:** Stored under `/users/{userId}` for path-based ownership. This ensures that only the user can access their profile data unless explicitly granted otherwise.
*   **Announcements:** Stored in a top-level `/announcements` collection. The `authorId` field is used to identify the creator. If specific roles (faculty, HOD) are required to create announcements, a separate `/roles_{role}/{userId}` collection could be used in security rules.
*   **Events:** Stored in a top-level `/events` collection. The `registeredUserIds` array allows for tracking registered users. If more complex registration management is required, a subcollection `/events/{eventId}/registrations/{userId}` could be used.
*   **Forum Posts:** Stored in a top-level `/forum_posts` collection. The `authorId` field identifies the creator. Upvotes and downvotes are tracked using arrays of user IDs.
*   **Resource Hub:** Stored in a top-level `/resources` collection.  The `uploaderId` field identifies the user who uploaded the resource. This structure allows all authorized users to upload, edit, and delete files.
*   **AI Chatbot Messages:** Stored in a top-level `/chat_messages` collection. The `userId` field identifies the user who sent the message.

This design ensures efficient and secure data management for CampusConnect.
